description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A small rectangular caddy has two empty cylindrical wells and a centered loop handle. Side: Each well sits inside a woven outer partition above a bamboo base. Rear: The rear partition and wrapped handle roots are fully visible. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
